name: profjero
description: ProfJero monorepo — the portfolio (profjero.pages.dev) and ProfJero Hub (profjerohub.pages.dev) with one shared codebase, admin dashboard and Firestore database.

scripts.dev:portfolio: node scripts/build.mjs portfolio && cd sites/portfolio && wrangler pages dev dist --port 8788
scripts.dev:hub: node scripts/build.mjs hub && cd sites/hub && wrangler pages dev dist --port 8789
